cross_family_language: SOURCE-NATIVE WIN-PROBABILITY / SIMULATION-FREQUENCY GAP for V3.1B-vs-MC2 WIN
d_readiness: D runs empirical historical analysis without redefining metrics
directional_change_semantics: numeric deltas primary; CONVERGING/DIVERGING/UNCHANGED purely descriptive (gap decreased/increased/exactly equal); no meaningful-change threshold
fusion_prohibition: no averaging, blending, stacking, meta-model, combined probability, majority vote, consensus leader, confidence/certainty score; not even placeholder interfaces
ground_truth_prohibition: no actual/observed/correct-source fields anywhere in C
kendall_semantics: tau-b, tie-aware; degenerate (no comparable ordered info) -> UNSUPPORTED; never substituted by Spearman
leader_scope_semantics: COMMON_UNIVERSE_LEADER_SET unless full candidate coverage proven for both sources (then FULL_FIELD_LEADER_SET); never unqualified 'predicted race leader'
leader_set_semantics: all drivers sharing best native value; exact-match vs overlap kept distinct diagnostics
magnitude_semantics: same state/driver/compatible-target/available/finite only; signed_gap = p_b - p_a; absolute_gap symmetric
mc_context_semantics: absolute_gap + mc_se + interval + inside-boolean exposed; NO significance threshold, NO confidence-disagreement score; inside != equivalence
mc_interval_semantics: Wilson 95% bounded interval; MONTE CARLO SAMPLING INTERVAL only; deterministic, no bootstrap
mc_se_semantics: SE_MC = sqrt(p(1-p)/n); finite-MC sampling variability ONLY; n<=0 unsupported; n never inferred
no_quality_ordering: primary = research role, never better; no winner/preferred/reliable-source outputs
normalization_prohibition: no race/sum normalization, softmax, simplex projection, or rescaling in C
race_macro_contract: per-race aggregates primary (equal weight); state-pooled never forced
rank_displacement_orientation: rank_b - rank_a; positive = numerically LOWER rank from B; descriptive only
rank_semantics: descending native probability/frequency; rank 1 = highest; input order never affects values
secondary_pairs: V3_5 top-k/MC2 derived top-k where exposed
signed_gap_orientation: positive = source B numerically higher; NOT more correct/confident/better
spearman_semantics: Pearson on average ranks over common comparable drivers (>=2); zero variance -> UNSUPPORTED (never 0/1/NaN)
stage_aggregation_contract: pure EARLY/MID/LATE utilities over supplied values (mean/median/support/race counts); frozen labels; D owns interpretation
summary_prohibition: never called error/loss/calibration error; no weighted combinations
support_accounting: candidate/A/B/common/excluded counts on every state metric; 12/20 stays visibly 12/20
temporal_trajectory_semantics: ordered exact-state observations; no interpolation/fill/nearest-lap; lap deltas + missing counts recorded
threshold_prohibition: no LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH, no 5/10/20pp cutoffs; continuous/descriptive quantities only
tie_semantics: AVERAGE RANK; ties never broken by identity, order, or randomness; deterministic serialization only
topk_boundary_tie_semantics: boundary ties included; requested_k + effective_set_size recorded; never cut through a tie
v35_p_win_lineage: SHARED_OR_DERIVED_LINEAGE for V3.1B-V3.5-control WIN pair (never two votes); DISTINCT_MECHANISM elsewhere
